audio.strategy: One lazy Web Audio context owns the inherited Piano A/B racks, Organ A/B source rendering into one shared Organ effect target, independent Synth A/B/C effect targets, one shared Rotary route, master gain, limiter, and one destination. Deterministic local renderers exercise the identical canonical parameters for cross-browser audio verification.

notes: All sound generation and processing is local and works without network access.
The isolated workspace supplied no redistributable acoustic-piano recordings. Grand, Upright, and Electric remain generated PCM plans, never described as recorded samples.
This preserves the inherited Phase 2 recorded-sample hard-gate deviation honestly; no provenance claim is fabricated.
A PCM-loading/startup failure reports a synthesized playable fallback rather than claiming the primary library is ready.

architecture.programState: One JSON-serializable InstrumentState round-trips section/layer state, every sound parameter, all six effect targets, splits/zones/crossfades, scenes, morph assignments, clock, and transpose. Master Level and held performance inputs are excluded on restore.
architecture.storage: Versioned localStorage contains 32 regular program snapshots and 8 auto-storing Live snapshots; the boundary is represented by ProgramStorageLike for deterministic tests.
architecture.voiceOwnership: Each pointer/keyboard/MIDI token owns its Piano, Organ, and Synth handles. Section/layer disable, note-off, pedal-up, Panic, disconnect, blur, and unmount release the appropriate handles; mono priority and arp hold are resolved per Synth layer.

controlAudit.functional: Every visible control not listed under unsupported has data-functional=true and changes canonical state, memory, routing, or audible parameters.
controlAudit.unsupportedPresentation: Spec-excluded controls remain tactile, expose data-functional=false, include '(unsupported)' in their accessible name, and are repeated in the UI footer and visual audit.
